durations: two minutes (Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell at nine)
whereabouts: Dr Vauthier dined with the family in the house on the last day of the year, as he does every year
At nine o'clock, Aurèle had the dinner guests show him their watches
After dinner, Vauthier and Madame sat down to piquet in the salon
Vauthier was playing piquet with Madame when the temple struck ten
Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat, at a quarter to eleven by his watch
Madame began to play the piano as Vauthier went out
Madame stopped playing the piano when Vauthier came back
Vauthier fetched his cigar case himself
